title: Igazi Lokuqala Elachitheka Ngomona
intro: Cabanga ngezinsuku zokuqala zesintu, lapho umhlaba wonke wawungumndeni owodwa. Ubukela njengoba iminikelo emibili ibekwa phambi kuka-Allah - omunye wamukelwa, omunye wenqatshwa. Umona uyagxila enhliziyweni, futhi usongo luhletshwa ngentukuthelo. Okulandelayo kuzoshiya uphawu emlandweni kuze kube phakade, ngisho nenyoni encane iyoba umfundisi.
clues: Nganikela umnikelo ku-Allah, kodwa owami awuzange wamukelwe ngenkathi omunye umnikelo usamukelwa.
Ngabona igwababa likhwehlela phansi ukuze lingibonise ukuthi singasifihla kanjani isidumbu.
Ngasala ngigcwele ukuzisola futhi ngaba phakathi kwabalahlekelwe yilokho izandla zami ezazikwenzile.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
